19. Gene-level data explorer

Browse the NetPert weight, degree, betweenness and driver PageRank of every gene in the real 1,200-gene Twist1 subnetwork (1,200 gene rows). Click a column header to sort. Gene symbols are searchable below.

Ranks are NetPert ranks over all 1,200 genes (competition ranking); Twist1 and the responses sit at the bottom by construction. Weights are normalised to sum to 1.
